name: codecanvas-research-companion
description: Resume research projects, review drafts and references, and work with authorised project evidence using CodeCanvas Research Companion.

interface.longDescription: CodeCanvas Research Companion helps students organise and resume their research projects, retrieve authorised project evidence, check references, format citations and review academic drafts. RC0.7 supports authenticated research continuity, source-overlap and citation-pattern analysis, and editing checks for changed numbers, quotations, citations and qualifications. Evidence and similarity checks cover available, authorised project sources rather than the whole internet; they do not independently verify a claim, establish misconduct, prove human authorship or guarantee detector evasion. Saving research or uploading evidence requires applicable consent. Academic decisions remain with the student and supervisor.
defaultPrompt: Resume my saved research project and recommend the next step.
Check the references and evidence supporting the claims in my draft.
Compare these two drafts for changes to numbers, citations and meaning.
